[quote=akhratia;58843322]how do you expand territory without paying for that paint.net thing[/quote]
paint.net is free: Also see this regarding expansion:

Expansion
You may expand every month. When expanding, you may claim up to 40,000 pixels in one go. To permanently render your expansion as yours, you have to write an appropriate amount of roleplaying proportional to the size of your claim. For reference, 1 word is worth 5 pixels. Your roleplaying may consist of worldbuilding in dispatches, storytelling on our RMB or anything that is directly related to the development of your new land.

Every update, we will check in on the people that have expanded to see how many words they have written. It is on you to be honest with how much writing you have really done. If you have made no progress on your expansion by 5 updates, your expansion will be declared void and we will revert it. We define no progress as either seeing no actual writing happen on your behalf or no change to the number of words you have written.
